concepts.name: 01-longhaul
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape exterior spaceship design mockup for a cozy single-player cargo delivery game. Reference image 1 is a contact sheet of the user's ship inspiration, use for industrial silhouette ideas only; reference image 2 is the ACTUAL existing Godot game and is the STRICT rendering complexity and material style target. Render as modest real-time Godot low-poly voxel graphics: chunky rectilinear construction, large flat untextured color surfaces, stepped corners made from boxes, simple hard shadows and restrained ambient occlusion. Absolutely no photorealism, no painted concept art, no tiny greebles, no distressed texture maps, no complex curves, no cinematic effects. Design an original civilian live-in cargo ship with believable space for separate cockpit, cozy hab, engineering and enclosed manually loaded cargo hold. No weapons. Muted cream, burnt orange, charcoal with concept-specific accent. Show a single complete ship in large front-left three-quarter view, nose pointing left, on a plain dark slate background with a simple ground plane and restrained soft lighting. All extremities fully within frame. Small secondary rear three-quarter view at bottom right to explain cargo hatch and engines. Main view occupies 80% of composition. Include a small voxel human beside closed loading hatch for scale. Warm amber cabin windows, dark teal cockpit glass. Small clean title top-left only. Designs must appear practical to construct with a few hundred simple box meshes, match reference 2's simplicity.
Text verbatim: "01 / LONGHAUL".
Specific ship design: A long narrow rectangular space-truck, about 25m long, single continuous enclosed hull. Blunt stepped wedge cab forward, generous rectangular hab windows behind, central cargo box with orange horizontal stripe, two squared aft engine nacelles tight against hull. Low underslung landing skids. Friendly utilitarian silhouette like a delivery van stretched into a freighter. Clearly defined rear loading ramp and side personnel airlock. Cream/orange.
